We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Sightline detection engineering team. You will design, build, and operate high-scale, low-latency backend services that score and protect web and API traffic against automated abuse, working at the core of HUMAN’s real-time detection platform.

What you’ll do:

  • High-Scale Engineering: Design, build, and maintain distributed, high-throughput backend services processing hundreds of thousands of requests per second with strict tens-of-milliseconds latency targets.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Own services from architecture and implementation to deployment and reliability. This includes full-stack instrumentation (monitoring, alerting, and tracing) to detect and mitigate production issues.

  • Product Innovation: Implement and evolve real-time detection and decisioning flows within the Sightline Cyberfraud Defense platform, collaborating with security researchers, data science, and product teams.

  • Cloud-Native Operations: Build and operate services in a Kubernetes environment using a modern GitOps stack (Go, Kafka, Redis, MongoDB, BigQuery, ArgoCD, Pulumi, Crossplane), ensuring robust rollout strategies and safe migrations.

  • AI-Forward Engineering: Demonstrate a deep passion for the AI-first development frontier and an expert-level ability to leverage assistants and agents to radically accelerate the entire lifecycle - from architectural scaffolding to automated tasks, skills, and complex debugging/testing.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with adjacent teams to design end-to-end flows that balance security, performance, and customer experience.

  • Technical Leadership: Contribute to technical design reviews and code reviews, raising the bar for quality and operational excellence across the team.

Who you are:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience building backend services with a strong grasp of modern distributed systems design.

  • Language Proficiency: High proficiency in at least one backend language such as Go, Java, or Scala, including a strong command of concurrency and multithreading concepts.

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Proven experience building and operating production systems in a major cloud provider (GCP or similar), including containerized workloads and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Data Systems: Hands-on experience with datastores and messaging systems (e.g., MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, or Postgres).

  • Networking & APIs: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, HTTP-based services, and best practices for secure, reliable APIs.

  • Troubleshooting: Practical experience with monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Opsgenie) and resolving complex, distributed production issues.

  • Delivery: Comfortable working both independently on complex technical problems and as part of a collaborative team, driving projects end-to-end.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in security, fraud detection, or risk scoring systems, especially in high-volume web or API environments.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with Go in production, including performance tuning, profiling, and optimizing latency-sensitive services for cost and availability at scale.

About HUMAN Security

HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.

HUMAN is an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to protecting the internet's integrity for everyone. We believe in putting people first, embracing diversity of thought from our global teams, and welcoming all individuals to share their unique experiences as we fight cybercrime together. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.

HUMAN is growing fast, and there’s never been a more meaningful time to join us. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to help shape the future of cybersecurity, join us as we build a safer, more human internet.

If you are an individual with a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us directly.

HUMAN Security helps organizations protect their digital businesses from bots and fraud. We’re looking for an Account Executive (a role often called Business Development Manager in other companies) who knows how to open doors, build relationships, and turn new opportunities into customers.

This is a true hunting role. You’ll own a defined list of target accounts, with the flexibility to pursue additional opportunities outside that list. You’ll be responsible for generating your own pipeline and managing the sales process from first conversation through close.

We’re looking for someone who has a proven approach to prospecting, can navigate complex sales cycles, and knows how to connect our solutions to the problems customers are trying to solve.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and execute account strategies to identify, engage, and win new customers.

  • Build your own pipeline through targeted outreach, networking, referrals, events, and channel partnerships.

  • Own the full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, qualification, technical evaluation, negotiation, and close.

  • Build relationships with decision-makers across marketing, digital, ecommerce, strategy, and technical teams.

  • Develop a strong understanding of HUMAN’s products and translate their value into business outcomes that matter to prospective customers.

  • Navigate complex buying groups, build compelling business cases, and know when to pursue an opportunity and when to walk away.

  • Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast, with clear next steps and an understanding of deal risks.

  • Partner with marketing, product, technical teams, and channel partners to move opportunities forward.

  • Adapt your approach when something isn’t working. We value persistence, but we also value good judgment.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, with a strong track record of winning new business.

  • A proven hunter who has personally sourced and closed new-logo opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound leads or an existing book of business.

  • Established relationships with decision-makers at enterprise brands and ecommerce companies, with a demonstrated ability to leverage those relationships to open doors and create new business opportunities.

  • Experience selling consultative solutions with annual contract values of $75K+, multiple stakeholders, and complex sales cycles.

  • A clear, repeatable approach to prospecting and account development, with results to back it up.

  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical solutions to customer priorities.

  • Comfortable learning complex products and explaining their value without getting lost in technical jargon.

  • Resilient, resourceful, and competitive, with the ability to adjust your approach when things don’t go according to plan.

  • Able to speak confidently and specifically about your results, including quota attainment, pipeline generation, and your contribution to closed deals.

  • Independent and accountable, but collaborative enough to bring in the right people at the right time.

Nice to have

  • Experience in cybersecurity, fraud prevention, marketing technology, ecommerce technology, or related enterprise solutions.

  • Experience building a territory or selling into a new market.

  • Familiarity with MEDDIC or a similar sales qualification methodology.

Come join us in the fight against bad bots and web threats!

HUMAN Security is looking for a driven and analytical Cyber Security Data Analyst to join our Customer Operations team. In this role, you'll work closely with global customers, analyzing their web traffic to identify malicious activity, uncover hidden threats, and distinguish between legitimate and malicious traffic.

You'll be part of a team at the forefront of the fight against cybercrime, working with large-scale datasets and collaborating with teams across the organization to help protect our customers from sophisticated cyber threats.

Please note: This role involves working shifts Sunday through Thursday (Israel time), with flexibility to provide weekend and holiday coverage when needed (not part of the regular schedule but an edge case).

What you'll do

  • Analyze customer traffic to identify undetected threats, suspicious activity, and false positives, primarily using ElasticSearch and Snowflake (SQL).

  • Provide real-time support to global customers, delivering timely, insightful, and technically sound responses to their security-related questions and challenges.

  • Investigate complex traffic patterns and detection logic, drawing data-driven conclusions and recommending appropriate actions.

  • Collaborate with R&D and Research teams to improve HUMAN Security's detection capabilities and ability to identify and mitigate cyberattacks in real time.

  • Work scheduled shifts as part of the role, including occasional weekend and holiday coverage when needed.

Who you are

  • You have a strong analytical mindset and a data-driven approach to problem-solving and decision-making.

  • You have excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, and strong customer-facing skills (a must).

  • You are passionate about data analysis, cybersecurity, and customer service.

  • You have 2+ years of hands-on experience analyzing large and complex datasets, including data manipulation, statistical analysis, and drawing meaningful insights.

  • You have strong SQL skills and experience working with data.

  • You have a good understanding of web architecture and protocols, including CDN, HTML, DOM, JavaScript, HTTP/HTTPS, and IPv4/IPv6.

  • You have a basic understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape and an interest in keeping up with emerging threats.

  • You are comfortable working in a dynamic, customer-facing environment that requires ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize tasks.

  • A B.A./B.S. in a relevant field is an advantage.

About HUMAN Security

The Research team at HUMAN is eager to protect the internet, and is passionate about innovating and winning against our attackers. As the ‘mind’ behind our products, we demand ourselves to bring our best and never stop learning attitude, eventually making our products’ trillions decisions per day as accurate as possible.

Our group includes data scientists and security researchers, working together towards reaching our goals and for mutual personal development. We’re currently looking for a talented data security researcher to join our team!

What you'll do:

  • Research and implement innovative ways to identify and block malicious activity.

  • Work closely with our development, Product and incident response teams.

  • Deal with huge amounts of data and use various tools to find solutions to complex problems.

  • Take part in a global core team in the company, made up of researchers and data scientists, and as such - you will have many opportunities to initiate and impact.

Who you are:

  • 3+ years of experience with data tools and platforms (SQL, Pandas, Kibana etc.).

  • A researcher mindset - knowledge in research methods and how to conduct a profound research.

  • A proven record of solving problems using data manipulation.

  • Deep knowledge and understanding on how the internet works.

  • Familiarity with the cyber and attack world, application level attacks is a plus.

  • Great motivation to invest in learning and development, as well as a desire to influence and constantly improve.

  • A strong sense of ownership which drives you to find ways to do things better, faster, and reduce costs.

  • A great team player - open, transparent and happy to work in close collaboration with other stakeholders.

  • Constantly drive for correctness and performance, in that order.

Come join us in the battle against bad bots and web threats! We are looking for driven and talented employees to work as Security Operation Analyst on our Customer Operations team.

As part of our leading team fighting off cybercriminals, you’ll be working side by side with customers, analyzing their traffic, and cleaning up the internet from bad bots. For this position, we are looking for someone who would be open to work on weekends (in rotation).

What you'll do:

  • Analyze customers’ traffic to identify undetected threats and false detections using mostly ElasticSearch (Kibana), SQL, Snowflake, etc.

  • Support customers in real-time and provide professional technical responses.

  • Work side by side with customers providing insightful incident reports.

  • Communicate with global customers and provide quick responses and resolutions.

  • Work cross-functionally with RnD and Research teams to optimize Human Security’s ability to detect and mitigate real-time Cyber Attacks.

  • Design, plan and implement projects and automation for internal use.

  • Follow runbooks to tune onboarding customers and retune existing customers.

  • Hold shifts as part of the job (including weekend shifts).

Who you are:

  • Excellent English communication skills are required, including clear, confident customer conversations and polished writing skills.

  • Analytical mindset and data driven decision making.

  • Passionate about data, security, and customer service.

  • Hands-on experience (1+ year) with data analysis of large and complex data sets (data manipulation, statistical analysis, conclusions, etc.).

  • Knowledge of web architecture and protocols (CDN, HTML, DOM, JS, HTTP, HTTPS, IPv4/v6, etc.).

  • Understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

  • SQL Proficiency.

  • Candidate must be domiciled in the PST time zone, Bay Area preferred

  • B.A/B.S in related domains.

The Research team at HUMAN is eager to protect the internet, and is passionate about innovating and winning against our attackers. As the ‘mind’ behind our products, we demand ourselves to bring our best and never stop learning attitude, eventually making our products’ trillions decisions per day as accurate as possible.

Our group includes data scientists, detection engineers, and security researchers, working together towards reaching our goals and for mutual personal development. We’re currently looking for a talented Senior Research Scientist to join Enterprise Research + Detection on the Detection Automation squad, reporting directly to the Chief Scientist and working closely with the Senior Director for Research+Detection for Sightline, the VP of Customer Success and Director of COPS, and VP of GTM.

What you'll do:

  • Research and implement innovative ways to identify and block malicious activity, then turn those methods into automated systems that run without a standing human in the loop.

  • Build and own internal tooling and services that enroll, refresh, and quality-check detections across customers, so protection ships as a normal part of the product rather than a long manual process.

  • Work with huge amounts of historical and live traffic data — warehouses, queries, and production write-paths — to find solutions to complex problems and to prove that a change is safe before it lands.

  • Partner closely with customer success, sales engineering, engineering, product, the rest of Research + Detection so research findings become reliable production behavior, with failures visible and guardrails in place.

  • Take part in a global core team of researchers and data scientists, with real opportunity to initiate work, reduce cost and toil, and raise detection quality.

  • Over time, extend that same automation mindset to how Research handles detection operations and escalations: shared tooling, agents where they help, and global solutions that scale to current and future customers.

Who you are:

  • 8+ years across large-scale data analysis, software engineering, tooling and process automation, and security research — you have shipped production systems, not only analyses.

  • Strong Python and SQL; comfortable owning warehouse-backed services (Snowflake or equivalent), internal apps, and the glue that takes a decision from query to written config.

  • A builder who removes operational queues. You have automated a recurring analyst/operator workflow so the happy path no longer needs a ticket, a checklist, or a human-in-the-loop.

  • A researcher mindset: you form a hypothesis, backtest on historical data, measure FP/FN, and only then write to production. Correctness, cost, and performance are equally important to you.

  • Knowledge of how the internet works (HTTP, clients, scanning, how traffic actually shows up in logs and warehouses). Familiarity with application-layer attacks, bot or vulnerability signatures, or threat-intelligence collection is a plus.

  • Proven record of solving messy, high-volume data problems — ingest, quality, scoring, and making failures visible instead of silent.

  • Strong sense of ownership: you find ways to do things better, faster, and cheaper, and you hold the quality bar when the easy path is “just dump more configs.”

  • A great team player — open, transparent, and effective with CS, SEs, support teams, and other researchers.

  • Based in the United States on Eastern Time, able to work closely with our Customer Success, Go-to Market teams, and with a global Research team.

  • Great motivation to keep learning, and a desire to influence the product rather than sit beside it.

What will set you apart:

  • You have built or extended internet-scale crawling, scanning, or threat-intelligence platforms, and you care about what happens when a detection is wrong.

  • You have automated signature or detector generation under a real false-positive constraint — ship fast, do not spray noisy rules onto production traffic.

  • You have stood up internal operator tooling (dashboards, Slack entry points, plan/state machines) that non-engineers can actually use.

  • You are at home with streaming and orchestration (Kafka, Airflow, Kubernetes) and with writing production services, not only notebooks.

  • You have taken something from 0→1: a system that did not exist, used by real operators, with an explicit fail/success state.

  • You treat “the human reviews every output” as a phase to exit, not as the product.

HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.

The Detection team at HUMAN is dedicated to protecting the internet by disrupting the economics of cybercrime. On Threat Research, we are responsible for identifying invalid traffic in the numerous forms it takes, understanding how the bad actors are monetizing the invalid traffic, and launching mitigations to stop them.

We are looking for a Researcher to join our team; someone who is curious, efficient, and possesses a relentless drive for improvement and will use those tools to manage the full-cycle of fraud fighting: from the early stages of exploratory research to the development and launching of statistical detection techniques.

What you’ll do

  • Investigate new and evolving forms of invalid traffic and ad fraud across programmatic advertising, web, and mobile environments. Understand what an actor is doing, how the activity is monetized, and what evidence distinguishes it from legitimate traffic.

  • Deploy robust defenses based on statistical analysis of supply chain data, network & JS signals, and fraud actor behavior.

  • Research emerging abuse patterns and develop practical ways to identify them, including browser automation, app spoofing, and other techniques used to evade detection.

  • Test detection ideas from an adversary’s perspective, including controlled experiments that probe how existing defenses might be bypassed, then use what you learn to improve them.

  • Work with Detection, Product, and Engineering partners to turn research into usable signals, product capabilities, and timely mitigations. This may include a short-term defense for an emerging threat and a more durable detection approach as the evidence develops.

  • Keep up with relevant changes in the ad tech ecosystem, industry standards, and attacker techniques; assess whether new data sources or tools could strengthen our detection.

  • Explain your findings clearly, including the evidence, limitations, and recommended next steps, so partners can act on the research.

Who you are

  • You have direct, hands-on experience with invalid traffic, ad fraud, or fraud detection in the ad tech or programmatic ecosystem. This domain experience is strongly encouraged.

  • Proficiency at writing performant SQL and Python on TB to PB of data, bonus points for Snowflake experience.

  • You’re comfortable working autonomously to identify a hypothesis, create a framework for evaluating it, and then investigate the evidence that supports or refutes this hypothesis, and dig into the ‘why’ of these results, even when the answer is not obvious.

  • You love puzzles and trying to think one step ahead of a fraudster; you look to find new and innovative ways to tackle complex problems through meticulous experimentation and application of emerging technologies

  • You take ownership of investigations, communicate what you learn, and collaborate well with technical partners as research moves toward implementation.

  • You can manage several investigations and adjust as new threats or priorities emerge.

About HUMAN Security

HUMAN was founded in a Brooklyn sci-fi bookstore with a hacker mindset and the lofty mission of making the internet safer by putting humans first. Today, our Human Defense Platform safeguards enterprises from sophisticated bots, fraud, and account abuse, verifying the humanity of more than 20 trillion interactions per week for the world’s biggest brands and internet platforms.

HUMAN is an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to protecting the internet's integrity for everyone. We believe in putting people first, embracing diversity of thought from our global teams, and welcoming all individuals to share their unique experiences as we fight cybercrime together. We support our Humans with a comprehensive total rewards package for personal and professional development, including well-being and learning stipends, flexible work options, and dedicated time off. While our HQ is in NYC, we have teams worldwide.

HUMAN is growing fast, and there’s never been a more meaningful time to join us. If you thrive on solving complex problems and want to help shape the future of cybersecurity, join us as we build a safer, more human internet.

If you are an individual with a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us directly.
